integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from exact distance formulas and monotonicity. The bundled symbolic checker is diagnostic only. Harmaala--Klén and Finch were materially inspected; the older unpublished Seittenranta licentiate thesis cited by Harmaala--Klén was not available in full and remains a residual originality risk.
scientific_limitations: Only the two-points-on-each-of-two-opposite-sides occupancy class is solved. Other side-occupancy patterns, and therefore the full exact Ptolemy constant of a rectangle, are not claimed.
title: Exact opposite-side Ptolemy branch for rectangles
